verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Basecamp exposing itself to external AI agents ("full MCP support" for ChatGPT and Claude, plus Skills and a CLI). That is the MCP-server role. Nothing shows Basecamp acting as an MCP client that connects to outside MCP servers and uses their tools, and server-side MCP support does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
